metadata.title: CSOAI Crosswalk — hash-anchored EU AI Act provisions to multi-framework controls
metadata.status: reference — not law, not certification, not a conformity assessment

honest_scope: This crosswalk maps 18 controls across 4 frameworks onto 21 EU AI Act provisions that are content-hashed to a dated snapshot. It is NOT a 417-provision corpus and does NOT cover 4 framework control-sets — claims to that effect elsewhere in this estate are unevidenced. Every link below is derived mechanically from an explicit Article citation in the control text, so each is checkable without trusting our judgement. Cross-framework equivalence (e.g. NIST to EU) is deliberately NOT asserted where no citation exists.

EU AI Act: Conformity assessment procedure (Art 43, Annex VI/VII) not modelled — requires a notified body.
GPAI model obligations (Chapter V, Art 51-56) not itemised in v1.0.0 — this set is high-risk + Art 50 transparency.
Art 50(2) machine-readable marking has a transitional period to 2 Dec 2026 for GenAI placed on market before 2 Aug 2026 — the control checks presence, not the date-conditional applicability.
Fundamental Rights Impact Assessment (Art 27) applies only to specific deployer categories — not universally gated here.
NIST CSF 2.0 Robotics: Covers GOVERN, PROTECT, DETECT. RESPOND and RECOVER are not yet specified for physical-harm incidents.
Does not cover functional safety standards (ISO 10218, ISO/TS 15066) — complementary, not substitutable.
Supply-chain (CSF GV.SC) not itemised in v1.0.0.
Solvency II P1: Does not cover Pillar 2 (governance/ORSA) — see solvency-ii-p3.json for reporting.
Does not model the standard-formula calculation itself; it checks that coverage is evidenced.
Group supervision (Art. 212-266) not covered in v1.0.0.
Solvency II P3: Quantitative Reporting Templates (QRTs) not itemised in v1.0.0 — only that reporting exists.
Does not cover the RSR (Regular Supervisory Report), which is supervisor-facing not public.
Audit requirements on the SFCR balance sheet vary by member state and are not modelled.
